messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH ERROR RATE detected for /v1/generate — 5xx and gateway timeouts increasing since 23:08 UTC. Affected: hosted API region us-west-2. Auto-escalation to oncall.
sara: acked. i'm on it, pulling graphs now.
jamal: seeing 5xx spike and a train of 429s right before. looks like quota service started returning 429s which led to retries and overloaded the gateway -> 5xx. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=errors&from=23:00&to=23:12
maria: checking quota service logs — there was a deploy ~23:03 that sets global default quota to 10/qps (should be 1000/qps). suspect misconfigured rollout. grabbing recent deploy id.
kevin: weirdly, downstream model hosts also show large queue lengths and some OOMs. if requests are being retried by clients after 429 that could blow up GPU pools.
sara: can we confirm deploy id and roll it back? if we can short-circuit quota check for known enterprise tenants that's a low-risk mitigation.
maria: deploy id = deploy-2026-03-15-2303 (infra/quota-service). pushing rollback now.
maria: (logs)
[2026-03-15T23:03:11Z] INFO applying config : global_quota: 10
[2026-03-15T23:04:02Z] WARN high reject rate
maria: rollback started — reverting to previous config (global_quota: 1000). ETA ~90s.
sara: putting a short-term rule to throttle retries at the gateway and enable fallback variant to low-cost model to reduce GPU pressure.
kevin: pushed gateway throttle: retry-after header enforcement and 30s backoff for clients. also enabled fallback-model-route for heavy tenants.
jamal: verifying metrics — 429s dropped after rollback started but still seeing elevated 5xx from model hosts. queue draining slowly.
support-bot: Customer impact summary: ~120 tenants experienced increased failed requests between 23:05-23:18 UTC. Top affected: tenant-corpA, tenant-startupB. Support runbook step: notify tier1 for customers with SLOs. (automated)
ops-oncall: paging oncall-sre for model host scaling — can we spin up extra dedicated instances? priority: tenant-corpA traffic surge.
kevin: scaling cluster nodes + adding 2x GPU workers now. will take ~3m to be ready.
jamal: while scaling, please also reduce cache TTLs to avoid stale prefixes filling memory — set prefix cache to 5s for affected pools.
maria: rollback completed at 23:06:55 UTC. quota service now returning normal limits.
sara: nice. 429s gone. 5xx tailing down, but still some late failures from previously queued requests. monitoring for 10m.
kevin: new workers online at 23:09:20 UTC. queue length halved. model hosts healthy, no new OOMs.
jamal: postmortem note: root cause = human error in quota config deploy (wrong default). cascade pattern: quota 429 -> client retries -> gateway/backends overloaded -> 5xx/timeouts. mitigations applied: immediate rollback, gateway retry-throttle, fallback-model route, cluster scale-up, cache TTL reduction.
sara: action items:
- maria: implement deploy-time validation to prevent extremely low global_quota values (PR by EOD) :white_check_mark:
- kevin: automated scale policy for sudden queue growth for model pools (investigate autoscale thresholds) :arrow_up:
- jamal: add a dashboard alert for 429->5xx cascade pattern (new panels + alert rule) :mag:
- ops-oncall: run customer outreach for top 5 affected tenants (support ticket template in #support)
maria: opened PR #4823 with a validator check and added a gating test. linking it here: https://git.re/rdw/pr/4823
support-bot: Created support tickets for tenant-corpA (INC-2026-00123) and tenant-startupB (INC-2026-00124).
sara: handing off to night oncall. ops-oncall — you're primary for the 12:00-16:00 UTC window. follow-up investigation and postmortem please. tagging @ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: acknowledged, taking over. i'll coordinate with support for customer comms and finalize the postmortem. will update thread in 1h or earlier if anything changes.
kevin: one small note — clients that aggressively retry on 429 made the cascade worse. we should add guidance to SDKs to use exponential backoff with jitter and honor retry-after. adding a ticket.
jamal: leaving final numbers in 30min: total failed requests ~18k, peak 5xx rate 4.5% (usual <0.2%). estimated extra cost from scale-up ~ $420 for the incident window.
sara: thanks all. closing initial incident response. ops-oncall and SRE to own postmortem and RCA. :thumbsup:
